reference.article: Chen T, et al. Comparison of Clinical Trial Changes in Primary Outcome and Reported Intervention Effect Size Between Trial Registration and Publication. JAMA Network Open. 2019;2(7):e197242.
reference.labelMeaning: The published study's classification of whether the trial had a primary-outcome change between registration and publication. It is a study label, not a finding of misconduct or clinical harm.

exclusionRules: No PubMed identifier resolved from the official PubMed search.
No single ClinicalTrials.gov identifier appeared in the PubMed record.
The publication exposed only a non-NCT registry identifier.
More than one NCT identifier appeared, making the pair ambiguous.
